name: waynestate/squire
description: The Citadel kit: standard build.sh, release script and health check, and local parity on the Citadel images.

suggest.waynestate/advisor: ADVISOR module: lets your coding agent run squire_doctor and squire_drift read-only.

scripts.a11y: echo "Front page accessibility gate: run scripts/a11y.sh (Linux, macOS) or scripts/a11y.ps1 (Windows). It stays out of composer ci because CI has no browser."

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, tests, style, static analysis, audit
scripts-descriptions.a11y: Print how to run the front page accessibility gate (scripts/a11y.sh on Linux and macOS, scripts/a11y.ps1 on Windows); it stays out of ci because CI has no browser
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail if the committed docs site is stale or a finding is present
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Regenerate the agent-ready files (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and the Markdown twins) from the site
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail if the committed agent-ready files are stale or a finding is present
scripts-descriptions.js: Run the docs kit JavaScript tests (needs Node)
